_comment: EXP-1170: the NEW ISSUE page, identical x4 (web lib/issue-draft-page.ts, desktop domain::issue_draft, iOS ExpCore IssueDraftPage, Android domain/IssueDraftPage). There is no create dialog: every New issue opener mints a draft uuid and navigates to the issue detail IN DRAFT MODE, the same layout as the detail with only these differences: the identifier slot reads `header`, the trailing cluster is a primary `create` button and a close (`ui-close`) button whose tooltip/accessibility label is `discard` (EXP-1191: no one-item overflow menu), the body is title (placeholder `titlePlaceholder`, focused on open), property chips (status, priority, assignee, labels, due date, a board picker when the team has more than one board; no estimate), description (placeholder `descriptionPlaceholder`) and the draft's Files, nothing else. AUTOSAVE: one coalesced `issueDrafts.upsert` of the full row, `debounceMs` after the last title/description edit, at once on a chip change, on blur, on leaving the page and before Create; a title, description or attachment is content, chips alone never create a row; leaving an emptied existing draft deletes it. A draft with no title lists as `untitled`.
